title: Lý thuyết WHICH – Choice & YES/NO questions

items.title: 1. WHICH - Choice questions: Câu hỏi lựa chọn
lines: • Tobe/ TĐT / Modal Verbs + … A ‘or’ B ?
VD: Which shirt do you like?
Do you prefer the black shirt, or the white one?

items.title: Cách trả lời thường gặp
items.note: KHÔNG TRẢ LỜI BẰNG YES / NO

cells:
The … one/ones (The white one)
… prefer/ like/ would like/ want/ choose…

Either /ˈaɪ.ðər/ /ˈiː.ðər/ (Either is fine)
Whichever (Whichever costs less)
It doesn’t matter to me.
It depends on … / I’m not sure yet/ …

items.title: 2. YES / NO questions: câu hỏi xác nhận thông tin
lines: 3 dạng câu hỏi thường gặp: Positive question (câu hỏi khẳng định), Negative question (câu hỏi phủ định), Tag question (câu hỏi đuôi)
VD: Did you do your homework? = Didn’t you do your homework?
= You did your homework, didn’t you?/ You didn’t do your homework, did you?
Trả lời: Yes, I did./ No, not yet.
I finished it yesterday. / I didn’t have time.
Cách trả lời cho 3 dạng câu hỏi trên là GIỐNG NHAU, có thể là:
